subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw own this Microsoft-specific tracker and PR-body updater as a committed repository workflow, or keep Microsoft cleanup in existing GitHub and ClawSweeper administration surfaces?
rationale: Mechanical repairs cannot decide whether a long-lived Microsoft-specific inventory is an intentional repository source of truth with an assigned owner and maintenance lifecycle.

options.title: Sponsor The Repository Tracker
options.body: Approve the direction after the generator safety, classification, verification, changelog, mergeability, and real-proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Keep It As Draft Metadata
options.body: Continue using the PR body and comments as temporary administration without merging the tracker file or generator into main.

options.title: Close The Tracker Direction
options.body: Close this PR and use GitHub searches, labels, and existing ClawSweeper reporting instead of adding another maintained inventory.

recommendation.title: Sponsor The Repository Tracker
recommendation.body: Approve the direction after the generator safety, classification, verification, changelog, mergeability, and real-proof blockers are resolved.
